# ADR 0004: Idempotency by client reference plus request fingerprint

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Core banking ledger

## Context

Mobile clients retry after timeouts; a retry must never post twice.

## Decision

Require a reference per request; store it uniquely with a SHA-256 hash of the payload. Same reference and payload returns the original receipt (200); different payload returns 409.

## Consequences

Safe retries; clear client contract. Clients must generate unique references.

## Alternatives considered

Idempotency-Key header stored in Redis (extra moving part for no gain here).
